title: Bills From Checking
subtitle: Every bill is paid from checking now, so the tracker no longer sets money aside in savings for bills. Savings on the Financial Summary is simply the bank balance.
intro: After the pull request merges, the code is already in your Sheet. I have already updated the rows in your Sheet: the car-payment pot is gone from Savings & Reserves, the car payment bill points to checking, and the rule that tagged the weekly CAR PAYMENT transfers is turned off.
**What does not change:** no transactions are removed. The money that was in the car-payment pot stays in savings and now counts as ordinary savings.

steps.text: In the Sheet, open **File → Version history → Name current version** and name it `Before bills from checking 2026-11-15`.
Open the **App Setup** tab and check that **Build Script Version** reads `1.24.1`. If it shows an older number, wait a minute and reload the Sheet.
Open **Finance Tracker → Upgrade workbook (keeps data)** and confirm.
steps.done: The upgrade finishes and shows its report.

steps.text: Open **Financial Summary**. At the top, **Savings** shows your savings bank balance.
steps.done: There is no faded "Savings + bill transfers" line under it any more.
There is no "Car payment money (parked in savings)" row. Its row is empty.

steps.text: In your bank, make sure the Capital One car payment is set to come out of **checking**, and stop the weekly CAR PAYMENT transfer from checking to savings if it is still scheduled.
steps.note: The tracker follows whatever the bank does; it cannot change the bank's settings.
